$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 257: a release runbook, and v0.8.0 prepared with it. Scope per the issue, all of it covered (so no covers block): notes, version sites, ratification record; 'the tag is a maintainer act' and is excluded by the issue itself, not left uncovered. Carries ADR-035's check (split to this issue from 223): the scope reaching tools/ and .claude-plugin/, the record, the count from tags, and the two-release expiry. Each was mutation-tested in the change: deleting the record, dropping ADR-034's row, a wrong count, a scope without tools/, and ADR-029 set back to Proposed (fails the expiry at 12). THE VACUITY THIS BAR IS BUILT AGAINST: a record that exists but lists nothing; C3 requires the check to pass, and the check fails on an omitted dependent. WHAT THIS BAR CANNOT CHECK: that the maintainer's ADR decisions were right.

criteria.$comment: C1 the runbook exists and covers ADR-035 duties
C2 every version site agrees on 0.8.0
C3 the record exists and the ADR-035 check accepts it (fails on a missing record, an omitted dependent, a wrong count, or an expired dependency)
criteria.target: bash -c 'test -f docs/adrs/RATIFICATION-v0.8.0.md && python3 conformance/skill.py | grep -q "\[PASS\] RATIFICATION-v0.8.0.md lists ADR-034 with a release count" && python3 conformance/skill.py'

criteria.$comment: C4 the ADR-035 scope includes tools/ and .claude-plugin/ and excludes only the named measurement tools
criteria.target: bash -c 'python3 conformance/skill.py | grep -q "\[PASS\] the ADR-035 scope reaches tools/ and .claude-plugin/" && grep -q "MEASUREMENT_TOOLS = {\"tools/live-equivalence.py\", \"tools/provider-readiness.py\"}" conformance/skill.py'

criteria.$comment: C5 release notes exist before the tag
